title: Charlottesville R Users
text:
Join us
Join the CRU mailing list for new event notifications.
Join the CRU Discord discussion during in-person events, meeting your fellow Charlottesville R Users, local job searching and posting, suggesting topics, and volunteering to present.


Sign up to present
Have an idea for a talk, lightning talk, workshop, panel discussion, or other event? Sign up here to volunteer to present at an upcoming event!


Upcoming events
See the event calendar at https://lu.ma/cru.
